Traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
Traits.text: Advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and supernatural effects.

Traits.name: Evasion
Traits.text: When subjected to a Dex save for half damage, take no damage on success and half on failure.

Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Qar makes an attack, he has Advantage on the attack roll.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Three Unarmed Strike attacks. If all three hit the same creature, target is Dazed until end of its next turn.

Actions.name: Unarmed Strike
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

Reactions.name: No Survivors
Reactions.text: When Qar can see an enemy drop to 0 HP, Qar moves up to his Speed. If he ends within 5 ft. of an enemy, he can make an Unarmed Strike.

Reactions.name: Voice Stealer
Reactions.text: 3/day. When an enemy Qar can hear within 30 ft. finishes casting a spell with a verbal component, it must succeed on DC 15 Intelligence save or be unable to speak for 1 minute (save ends end of turn).

LegendaryActions.name: Party Tactics
LegendaryActions.text: Qar and each ally within 60 ft who can see or hear can move up to their speed.

Description: Mobile skirmisher. Hunt casters/isolated PCs, use Voice Stealer to interrupt key verbal spells, and keep pressure on anyone trying to reach the Supervisor. Iron Ring 2/day.
